svg.title: The problems of the search in the end-to-end tests
svg.desc: run.sh searches as e2e-user for e2e-error, which the mock answers with HTTP 500, and the search shows no documents and records a failed search. Then it searches for e2e-drop; the mock breaks off the first request without an answer, the app sends it a second time and gets the document, and the history records the second try and that searches work again. assert_history.py checks the page of the administration settings, without the terms and the token. accessibility.mjs checks that page with axe-core, then clicks Clear history, and assert_history.py checks that the page says No problem recorded.
